verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs say bot management is built into the network and runs on every request, so apps deployed on Workers get automated-bot protection by default. Nothing in the pack describes an invisible or challenge-based mechanism, how a developer configures it, or how it integrates with a Worker. missing for 10: evidence of invisible challenge-based verification (e.g., a challenge widget or token validation), developer integration docs for Workers, configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can protect my app from automated bot traffic with invisible challenge-based protection

citations.quote: DDoS protection, WAF, bot management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network and run on every request from day one.
